releaseNotes: Retire every reference to the Formation-Platform repository. That project is no longer worked on, and nothing here cited it: the twelve source-registry rows named locations (STRATEGY.md, docs/b2c-product-faq.md, plans/...) that live in that repository, not this one.
Drop those rows and the twelve source-freshness snapshot entries carrying their scraped page titles, so the registry describes only sources this repository actually reads.

Remove Formation-Platform from the private-source allowlist in tooling/lib/source-http.ts and from the auth-mapping fixture. b2c-app-builder stays until this repository is public; issue #152 removes the branch once nothing is private.
Realign package.json with skill-version.json, which had drifted a patch apart, and stop naming a retired project as a live PostHog project in the app Worker README.
